features.text: 完成 Phase 2 发布基线：管理员双因素认证、一次性恢复码、细粒度 API Token、审计查询和默认关闭的内嵌 MCP。
加入分块上传、服务端恢复、Web 断点续传、Range 下载和分享访问控制。

fixes.text: 修复并发上传、下载额度抢占和最终化恢复之间的竞态。
修复无 WebCrypto 的 LAN HTTP 浏览器无法计算上传分块 SHA-256 的问题。

security.text: 增加结构化发布门、严格权限检查和文件响应安全头；依赖审计的 Critical/High 已清零。

upgrades.text: 要求 Node.js 20.17.0 或更高版本，并从 v0.2.5 起支持面向 managed layout 的自动更新。
旧式源码部署升级到 managed layout 前需要一次手动 bootstrap。

known_issues.text: 发布门要求使用同一候选制品提供 375px、TOTP/恢复码和刷新后续传的人工验收证据。
现有 Moderate/Low 依赖审计告警仍需按 CURRENT-STATE 的风险记录继续处理。

features.text: Complete the Phase 2 baseline with administrator two-factor authentication, one-time recovery codes, scoped API tokens, audit queries, and an opt-in embedded MCP service.
Add chunked uploads, server-side recovery, browser resume after refresh, Range downloads, and controlled share access.

fixes.text: Fix races across concurrent uploads, download-quota claims, and finalization recovery.
Fix upload chunk SHA-256 calculation in LAN HTTP browsers without WebCrypto.

security.text: Add a structured release gate, strict permission checks, and safe file-response headers; no Critical or High audit findings remain.

upgrades.text: Require Node.js 20.17.0 or newer; managed-layout automatic updates begin with v0.2.5.
Legacy source deployments require a one-time manual bootstrap before moving to the managed layout.

known_issues.text: The release gate requires manual acceptance evidence from the same candidate artifact at 375px, for TOTP/recovery, and for resume after refresh.
Existing Moderate/Low dependency audit advisories remain tracked in CURRENT-STATE.
